facts.fact: iXAfrica Data Centres' NBOX1 hyperscale data centre on Mombasa Road, Nairobi, first launched in July 2024, is live with 780 racks and 4.5MW of IT capacity (part of a 22.5MW campus), was unveiled in its first phase in February 2025, and is described as ready to host hyperscale and government workloads (Developing Telecoms).
